description: Repairs r-cplx-rebuild/create-cx-types: only MByte received V, because TableDefs.Item('M<Kind>') returned 3265 right after the DDL on a TableDefs collection that was not refreshed. Fixture r-fix-cat-txn-cx-types-accdb (ACCDB): eight tables M<Kind>(ID COUNTER primary key, Name) each with one multi-valued field V created through CreateField with dbComplexByte 102, Integer 103, Long 104, Single 105, Double 106, GUID 107, Decimal 108 and Text 109, TableDefs refreshed before each lookup (DBEngine.Errors after each Append); parent p1 with two typed child values (Decimal values as VT_CY, so no BSTR conversion depends on the locale), parent p2 with none. The Database is closed and reopened read-only and the group of p1 and of p2 of each table is read.
